1 0:27 How often do people say they laugh at work??People said they rarely or seldom laugh at work. One person joked that they study climate change, so why would they laugh.
2 0:47 How is humour typically viewed as a workplace asset??It is not. The speakers say humour is one of the most underappreciated assets at work, even though research shows it has real benefits.
3 1:23 What does the humour cliff chart indicate??It shows that people laugh frequently as children, but laughter drops sharply when they enter the workforce around age 23, and it does not recover until retirement.
